_readme: Live-upgrade config for scripts/live-upgrade.cjs. Chain addresses for all five live chains were verified read-only on 2026-11-17 (owner()==timelock, minDelay==72h, proposer/executor roles, platformFeeRate()==100, V1 implementation slot). `charities` is INTENTIONALLY EMPTY — fill it with your real payout addresses; do NOT copy the placeholder 0x1111… set. `verified` stays false until you confirm the addresses/keys; flip it to true to let the mutating commands sign.
_capBasis: Stage-1 caps USD 500/tx and USD 2,500/24h converted to token units at 90-day average USD prices (CoinGecko daily samples): ETH $2,416.92, POL $0.0981, AVAX $8.868, ARB $0.164. Caps are stored in TOKEN UNITS because DurationDonation has no price oracle. Values are truncated (round down) to be conservative; at current spot they are worth ~$370-420, i.e. tighter than a full $500. Recalibrate quarterly via the timelocked setTokenConfig op.

_policy.nativeTokens: Native address(0) is DISABLED: the webapp donation hook throws for native tokens (src/hooks/web3/useDonation.ts), so enabling it only widens the cap surface. Flip enabled:true if direct native callers must be supported.
_policy.sixDecimalStablecoins: USDC/USDT are DISABLED: MINIMUM_DONATION is a hardcoded 1e15 token units, so 6-decimal donations (e.g. 100e6 = $100) always revert. Needs a per-token minimum in a future V2. USDC/USDT amounts are listed in the runbook for when that lands.
_policy.perTokenSemantics: Caps are per-token: the rolling 24h bucket is separate per token address, so the aggregate daily ceiling on a chain is (number of enabled tokens) x USD 2,500. Currently: Base/Ethereum/Polygon/Avalanche 2 tokens = USD 5,000/day; Arbitrum 3 tokens = USD 7,500/day.
